entries.title: Sample content note
entries.excerpt: The posts and pages that come with a new site are samples. Replace them with your own writing, or delete them.

entries.title: About
entries.excerpt: This is the About page that comes with every new site. It describes who writes here and what readers will find, and it's yours to rewrite. A short About page answers three questions. Who are you?…

entries.title: Site author
entries.excerpt: Every post on this site names its author and links here. Replace this text with a few sentences about the person or group who writes. Say who you are, what you write about, and why a reader might…

entries.title: Contact
entries.excerpt: Write to us at hello@example.com. That address is a placeholder. Replace it with the address where you want to hear from readers, in both the link and the text. This site has no contact form, so…

entries.title: Every element on this site
entries.excerpt: One post that shows how each kind of markdown and each block renders, so you can see them side by side.

entries.title: Restore an earlier version
entries.excerpt: Bring back a version of a post or page you published before.

entries.title: Invite an editor
entries.excerpt: Add a person to the list of people who can sign in and write on your site.

entries.title: Link to another page
entries.excerpt: Link to a page or post on your own site so the link keeps working when you rename the target.

entries.title: Add an image to a post
entries.excerpt: Upload a picture, describe it for readers who can't see it, and place it in your text.

entries.title: Add a page
entries.excerpt: Create a page such as About or Pricing, which has an address and no date.

entries.title: Write your first post
entries.excerpt: Start a post in the editor, save it as a draft, and publish it to your site.
